data.title: United-Guardian Reports Second Quarter Results
data.description: Hauppauge, New York - United-Guardian, Inc. (NASDAQ:UG) shared its financial performance for the second quarter and first half of 2026. In the second quarter, net sales saw a significant 10% rise, climbing from $2,838,225 in 2025 to $3,108,267 in 2026. Net income also surged by 16% from $626,826 ($0.14 per share) to $728,579 ($0.16 per share). Looking at the six-month period ending on June 30, net sales increased by 12% from $5,319,352 in 2025 to $5,980,489 in 2026. Similarly, net income witnessed a substantial 30% boost from $1,187,721 ($0.26 per share) to $1,547,481 ($0.34 per share) during this period.

data.title: Union launches ratification process on tentative agreement with WestJet
data.description: In Calgary, CUPE 8125, the union representing WestJet flight attendants, has initiated the ratification process after reaching a tentative agreement with the airline following lengthy negotiations. The specifics of the agreement have been disclosed to members and will be deliberated during forthcoming meetings set for next week. Once these meetings conclude, the voting process will commence. The union views this tentative agreement as a significant step forward for WestJet flight attendants.

data.title: PrintMail Solutions Joins the Jack Henry™ Fintech Integration Network
data.description: PrintMail Solutions, a prominent provider of print and digital customer communications management services for financial institutions like banks and credit unions, recently revealed its partnership with the Jack Henry® Fintech Integration Network (FIN). By becoming a part of this network, PrintMail gains access to Jack Henry’s technical support, facilitating the integration of its print and ePresentment solution with Jack Henry’s core platforms. The collaboration through the Fintech Integration Network aims to ensure seamless compatibility and efficiency in financial technology services.

data.title: American Society of Hematology Names Matthew Gertzog Chief Executive Officer; Martha Liggett to Retire After Three Decades of Leadership
data.description: On August 7, 2026, the American Society of Hematology revealed that Matthew Gertzog, FASAE, MBA, is set to become the organization's new CEO starting January 1, 2027. Gertzog will be taking over from Martha "Marty" Liggett, Esq., in this role.

data.title: Here Come Bold Stripes and Bright Stars
data.description: In Linthicum Heights, Maryland on August 7, 2026, the U.S. Postal Service unveiled its latest postage envelope at the BALPEX stamp show. The new Diagonal U.S. Flag Forever envelope showcases a patriotic red, white, and blue digital design depicting the American flag.

data.title: Pulse Health Launches Pulse Media, Bringing Precision HCP Advertising to the Pulse Engagement Cloud
data.description: Pulse Health, a prominent provider of cloud-based engagement technology for the life sciences sector, has introduced a new service that integrates precise digital media strategies with synchronized omnichannel outreach to enhance the engagement of healthcare professionals. The offering was unveiled on August 7, 2026 in Garden City, N.Y. This innovative approach aims to significantly improve interaction with healthcare professionals, leveraging targeted digital media tactics alongside coordinated omnichannel outreach. Pulse Health's focus on streamlining engagement is set to revolutionize how the industry connects with healthcare professionals.

data.title: Keys Inc. Launches AI-Powered Nationwide Key Distribution Network for Locksmiths
data.description: Keys Inc., based in Tucson, Arizona, announced on August 7, 2026, that they are facilitating direct connections between locksmiths and key distributors. Their AI-powered platform assists in identifying the right key, comparing local supply options, placing instant orders, and obtaining inventory swiftly. This service aims to streamline the process for locksmiths and promote efficiency in acquiring keys.
